orchestration_contract.parent_ownership: The orchestrator process directly spawns and awaits supervisor, each control request, the SDK runner and cleanup commands with detached=false and shell=false.
orchestration_contract.readiness: The parent waits for the supervisor state file to report serving before controls or the runner start.
orchestration_contract.cleanup: Every configured cleanup command runs in order after success or failure even if an earlier command closes the supervisor; every attempt and failure is recorded, then the parent verifies supervisor close and escalates only after the bounded close wait.
orchestration_contract.lifecycle_capture: Every direct child captures error, stdout, stderr, exit, close and signal events. Owner-only stdout/stderr files are persisted under evidence/orchestration, and the SDK runner output is also written to the reviewed runner.stdout/runner.stderr preflight files.
orchestration_contract.freshness: The optional receipt path and orchestration capture directory are checked absent before preflight can mutate the control root; preflight then runs in the same parent before the supervisor starts.
orchestration_contract.failure_policy: A failed control or SDK runner stops forward phases, still runs every configured cleanup command in order, returns status failed for any cleanup failure and performs no retry.

assertions: direct children share the orchestrator parent PID
server and client exit/close/signal lifecycle is captured
runner stdout/stderr are persisted to preflight output files
failure phases skip forward work and still execute cleanup
stale orchestration capture is rejected before preflight runner-output mutation
stale optional receipt is rejected before preflight, capture or child mutation
every cleanup command runs in order after an earlier cleanup closes the supervisor
every cleanup attempt and failure is recorded before supervisor closure verification
shutdown cleanup is awaited before forced supervisor termination

future_config_boundary.supervisor: exact reviewed fresh-root supervisor.mjs serve command
future_config_boundary.controls: exact fresh-root control commands, supplied as shell-free argv arrays
future_config_boundary.runner: existing SDK browser runner with fresh private environment paths
future_config_boundary.cleanup: exact fresh-root cleanup/shutdown commands, supplied as shell-free argv arrays

proof_boundary: This proves only source-level orchestration and fake process lifecycle behavior. It is not browser, SDK API, TLS, CA import, CORS, Hub API, package journey, service, release, production, vehicle or user acceptance evidence.
